question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: select sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false)

question: How many orders were placed?
gold_sql: select count(distinct order_id) as orders from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false)

question: What is the total GMV?
gold_sql: select sum(line_gmv) as gmv from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false)

question: How much freight revenue did we earn?
gold_sql: select sum(line_freight) as freight_revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false)

question: How many items were sold?
gold_sql: select count(*) as items_sold from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false)

question: How many unique customers bought something?
gold_sql: select count(distinct customer_unique_id) as unique_customers from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false)

question: Revenue by month
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('month', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__month, sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Orders by month
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('month', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__month, count(distinct order_id) as orders from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Revenue by week
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('week', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__week, sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Revenue by quarter
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('quarter', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__quarter, sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Revenue by year
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('year', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__year, sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Revenue by customer state
gold_sql: select customer_state as order_item__customer_state, sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Revenue by product category
gold_sql: select product_category_en as order_item__product_category, sum(case when not coalesce(is_canceled, false) then line_revenue else 0 end) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items group by 1

question: Items sold by seller state
gold_sql: select seller_state as order_item__seller_state, count(*) as items_sold from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1

question: Items sold by product category
gold_sql: select product_category_en as order_item__product_category, sum(case when not coalesce(is_canceled, false) then 1 else 0 end) as items_sold from analytics.fct_order_items group by 1

question: Revenue by month and customer state
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('month', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__month, customer_state as order_item__customer_state, sum(case when not coalesce(is_canceled, false) then line_revenue else 0 end) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items group by 1, 2

question: Revenue in SP
gold_sql: select sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) and customer_state = 'SP'

question: Revenue for bed bath table
gold_sql: select sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) and product_category_en = 'bed_bath_table'

question: Delivered orders
gold_sql: select count(distinct order_id) as orders from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) and order_status = 'delivered'

question: Revenue since February 2017
gold_sql: select sum(line_revenue) as revenue from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) and purchased_at >= '2017-02-01'

question: Total payment value
gold_sql: select sum(payment_total) as payment_value from analytics.fct_orders where not is_canceled

question: Payment value by payment type
gold_sql: select payment_type_primary as order__payment_type, sum(payment_total) as payment_value from analytics.fct_orders where not is_canceled group by 1

question: Average installments per order
gold_sql: select avg(payment_installments_max) as avg_installments from analytics.fct_orders where not is_canceled

question: Average review score
gold_sql: select avg(review_score) as avg_review_score from analytics.fct_orders

question: Average delivery days by month
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('month', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__month, avg(delivery_days) as avg_delivery_days from analytics.fct_orders group by 1

question: On time delivery rate
gold_sql: select (count(delivery_days) - sum(case when is_late then 1 else 0 end))::numeric / count(delivery_days) as on_time_delivery_rate from analytics.fct_orders

question: Late delivery rate by customer state
gold_sql: select customer_state as order__customer_state, sum(case when is_late then 1 else 0 end)::numeric / nullif(count(delivery_days), 0) as late_delivery_rate from analytics.fct_orders group by 1

question: Cancellation rate
gold_sql: select sum(case when is_canceled then 1 else 0 end)::numeric / count(*) as cancellation_rate from analytics.fct_orders

question: Share of orders from returning customers
gold_sql: select count(*) filter (where customer_order_seq > 1)::numeric / count(*) filter (where not is_canceled) as repeat_customer_rate from analytics.fct_orders

question: Average order value by month
gold_sql: select cast(date_trunc('month', purchased_at) as date) as metric_time__month, sum(line_revenue)::numeric / count(distinct order_id) as aov from analytics.fct_order_items where not coalesce(is_canceled, false) group by 1
